notes.title: ⏳ Party Madness Devlog #1 ⏳
notes.content:
[p]Hello [b]Party Madness[/b] family!
[/p][p]While that little “Coming Soon” badge has been sitting on our Steam page, the team has been hard at work behind the scenes. What exactly have we been cooking up? In this very first devlog we’re lifting the curtain—just a bit—to show you!    


1) “Trap of Octopus” Mini-Game – Eight-Armed Chaos 🐙 
[/p][p]One of the early mini-games takes place on a rickety dock where a giant kraken tries to smack players into the sea with its tentacles.  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579048/3b838cb7a0a8387b3f3472547b89c3f6f01f069c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]2) “Circle of Ancients” – PvP 🌴   

Our brand-new environment is a circular stone platform ringed by hungry hazards. Can you escape from the traps?     

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579048/40a3fd0320ef482426ab5027a9cf993050d3ac4c.png"][/img]
3) Fighters – [b]Samurai[/b] Enters the Ring ⚔️ 
[/p][p]We’ve designed [b]25 different characters[/b]—plenty of personalities to pick from at demo.     
       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579048/a67a7653f6497764e70973454a6c0e36e1b806e3.png"][/img]4) Join the Party!  
ːsteamhappyːDiscord Server : [url="https://discord.gg/q3Syd6thF2"]https://discord.gg/q3Syd6thF2[/url][/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579048/d3b31e106feb47b2635534aaaf2f3c0d0c2711ad.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Party on, everyone! 🎉[/p][p]— The [b]Payoff Games[/b] team[/p]
